name: Hybrid Multi-Space Module
definition: A module that extends grid-based NeRF methods (like iNGP) to handle multiple sub-spaces (e.g., reflections/refractions) by decomposing the multi-space gate information into a small MLP branch, while the main branch models multiple radiance fields.
summary: The Hybrid Multi-Space Module extends grid-based NeRFs to render complex light paths by modeling K distinct radiance fields for sub-spaces, enabling accurate handling of reflections and refractions.
